title: A frontend unit test file fails intermittently in the full parallel run
actual: First run: 2 of 478 failed (both in PhotoViewer.test.tsx); the file alone passes 5/5; second full run 478/478. Matches TD-025 (parallel transform race).
impact: Occasional false-red CI and lost trust in the gate.
fix: Apply TD-025's fix (isolate: false or a single retry for transform errors) and check the test for timer/animation waits.
